info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Payments Payments Charge-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Processing API facilitates the secure and efficient handling of payment transactions for users. This API allows businesses to charge customers using various payment methods, ensuring a seamless checkout experience. It is designed for merchants, e-commerce platforms, and any application requiring integrated payment capabilities. With this API, companies can delegate payment processing responsibilities, enabling focus on core business operations while ensuring compliance and security.

post.description: This operation processes a payment charge for a given transaction. It validates payment details and interacts with the payment gateway to complete the transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a charge payment. It requires specific information about the transaction being processed, including details such as the payment method, amount to be charged, and any necessary identifiers for handling the payment correctly.

200.description: The payment charge was processed successfully.
